counterexample_mapping.boundary: one shared per-document LAST ACTUAL fact store; the full intended facts are stored before the terminal persistence; the recovery rewrites the ATTEMPTED name from those facts and joins the original error

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the verdict is a FAIL when the original failure is not None; a failed evidence write updates the store and the error list and the evidence is closed after the cleanup with the priority of the cleanup

counterexample_mapping.boundary: a durable final summary is written once after every inventory action: the states, the names not persisted, the full facts, the original failure and every additional write error; it never replaces the original exception

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the seam retains the exact object of the cancellation and the phase raises that object; the exact objects stay in memory and the documents show the type and the detail separately

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the zero, parent and controlled evidence writers consult the pending list first and re-raise the first exact interruption; the priority is unwinding original > first exact pending interruption > ordinary proof/evidence assertion

counterexample_mapping.boundary: every cleanup release of the module is guarded on its own by one helper; a cancellation of one gate never skips the second gate, the closes, the stop, the joins, the proof and the evidence
